content.summary: According to the company, the closure is part of its effort to streamline operations and focus on lower-cost growth channels.

content.title: Another apparel brand is closing its retail stores. It was once a tech bro favorite
content.summary: A growing number of retailers are reducing their physical footprint in favor of e-commerce, and the latest was once a Silicon Valley staple.

content.title: Allbirds is closing its last brick-and-mortar store in San Francisco
content.summary: Once symbolic of a mid-2010s San Francisco tech bro, Allbirds is cutting costs to "support the long-term health of the business."

thumbnail.caption: NEW YORK, NEW YORK - AUGUST 31: People walk past an Allbirds store, a maker of sustainable shoes, in lower Manhattan on August 31, 2021 in New York City. The shoe company has announced that it is preparing an initial public offering (IPO). The company has lost money and expects it will continue to be unprofitable for the foreseeable future. content.title: Allbirds to Close Remaining Full-price U.S. Stores
content.summary: Allbirds to close all U.S. full-price store closures to be more profitable; it will keep open two U.S. outlet stores and two London full-price stores.

content.title: Allbirds to close all US stores, save 2 outlets
content.summary: The one-time DTC darling operated more than 60 locations at its peak, but will have just four company-run stores globally by the end of February.

thumbnail.caption: Allbirds is one of many DTC brands to open a store on Abbot Kinney Boulevard in California.
